name: Micro-lesson (educational)
description: Mini conversational class delivering a 5-minute lesson on a chosen topic. Asks for a topic, picks a format (mind-map, case study, quick-reference), and emits a scaffolded outline the persona expands into voice. Pre-wired with slot inheritance from the lead-capture recipe so a returning visitor reuses their name. Distills the Aula-Relâmpago pattern from the Education customer engagement (§VII.3.1 — determinism + LLM hybrid).

chatFlow.name: Micro-lesson (educational)
chatFlow.description: Short conversational class on a chosen topic. Asks topic + format, then emits a 5-minute lesson scaffold.
chatFlow.triggerDescription: Ativar quando o visitante pedir uma aula relâmpago, mini-aula, lição rápida, resumo de conceito ou explicação curta sobre algum tema educacional. NÃO ATIVAR para perguntas operacionais sobre matrículas ou preços.
